items.description: UCLA scored the final 21 points, including two touchdowns by Wayne Knight, to give new head coach Bob Chesney a 45-24 win over former Pac-12 rival Cal in both team's season opener.

items.headline: UCLA opens Bob Chesney era with a 45-24 win over former Pac-12 rival California
items.description: — Wayne Knight ran for two touchdowns in the fourth quarter following interceptions by Ta'Shawn James and UCLA opened the Bob Chesney era with a 45-24 victory over California on Saturday night.
